title: Moisturizers Step 1
description: Apply a hydrating moisturizer to clean skin.
details: Gently massage a pea-sized amount of moisturizer onto your face and neck in upward motions.
tips: Apply after cleansing for best absorption.
Use morning and night for optimal hydration.

title: Moisturizers Step 2
description: Lock in moisture with a thicker cream.
details: Apply a lightweight cream or lotion to seal in the initial layer of hydration.
tips: Choose a cream suited for your skin type.
Avoid over-application to prevent clogged pores.

title: Moisturizers Step 3
description: Protect with a moisturizer containing SPF.
details: Finish with a broad-spectrum SPF moisturizer during the day to shield skin from UV rays.
tips: Reapply SPF every 2 hours if exposed to sunlight.
Use a non-comedogenic product for oily skin.

title: Cleansers Step 1
description: Cleanse face with a gentle cleanser.
details: Use a small amount of cleanser, lather with water, and massage gently onto wet skin.
tips: Use lukewarm water to avoid irritation.
Cleanse twice daily for best results.

title: Cleansers Step 2
description: Rinse thoroughly and pat dry.
details: Rinse off all cleanser residue with lukewarm water and gently pat skin dry with a clean towel.
tips: Avoid hot water to prevent dryness.
Use a soft towel to avoid irritation.

title: Cleansers Step 3
description: Follow with a toner or moisturizer.
details: After cleansing, apply a toner or moisturizer to restore skin’s balance and hydration.
tips: Choose a toner suited to your skin type.
Avoid over-cleansing to maintain natural oils.

title: Serums Step 1
description: Apply a lightweight serum to clean skin.
details: Dispense 2-3 drops of serum and gently pat onto face, focusing on problem areas.
tips: Use after cleansing but before moisturizing.
Allow serum to absorb fully before next step.

title: Serums Step 2
description: Target specific concerns with a second serum.
details: Apply a second serum if targeting multiple concerns, such as hydration or brightening.
tips: Layer serums from thinnest to thickest.
Wait 1-2 minutes between applications.

title: Serums Step 3
description: Seal with a moisturizer.
details: Lock in serums with a moisturizer to enhance their efficacy and hydrate skin.
tips: Use a heavier cream at night.
Ensure full absorption for best results.

title: Toners Step 1
description: Apply toner to clean skin.
details: Soak a cotton pad with toner and gently swipe across face, avoiding the eye area.
tips: Use after cleansing to remove residue.
Choose alcohol-free toners for sensitive skin.

title: Toners Step 2
description: Pat toner into skin for better absorption.
details: Use clean fingertips to gently pat remaining toner into skin for deeper penetration.
tips: Focus on areas prone to dryness.
Avoid over-soaking the cotton pad.

title: Toners Step 3
description: Follow with serum or moisturizer.
details: Proceed with a serum or moisturizer to lock in the toner’s benefits and hydrate skin.
tips: Use a hydrating serum for added benefits.
Apply within 1 minute to trap moisture.

title: Sunscreens Step 1
description: Apply sunscreen as the last skincare step.
details: Use a quarter-sized amount of broad-spectrum SPF 30+ and apply evenly to face and neck.
tips: Apply 15 minutes before sun exposure.
Use daily, even on cloudy days.

title: Sunscreens Step 2
description: Reapply sunscreen every 2 hours.
details: Reapply sunscreen throughout the day, especially after swimming or sweating.
tips: Carry a travel-sized sunscreen for convenience.
Use a powder SPF for touch-ups over makeup.

title: Sunscreens Step 3
description: Combine with a moisturizer for added hydration.
details: Opt for a sunscreen-moisturizer hybrid for convenience and enhanced skin hydration.
tips: Choose a non-greasy formula for oily skin.
Ensure SPF coverage is not diluted.

title: Face Masks Step 1
description: Apply a face mask to clean skin.
details: Spread an even layer of the mask over your face, avoiding eyes and mouth.
tips: Use 1-2 times per week for best results.
Choose a mask based on your skin’s needs.

title: Face Masks Step 2
description: Leave mask on for recommended time.
details: Follow the mask’s instructions, typically 10-20 minutes, then rinse or peel off.
tips: Relax while the mask works.
Avoid leaving on longer than recommended.

title: Face Masks Step 3
description: Follow with toner or moisturizer.
details: After removing the mask, apply toner or moisturizer to lock in benefits.
tips: Use a hydrating toner for extra moisture.
Apply a night cream for overnight repair.

title: Eye Creams Step 1
description: Apply a small amount of eye cream.
details: Use a rice-grain-sized amount and gently dab around the eye area with your ring finger.
tips: Use your ring finger for minimal pressure.
Apply after serums but before moisturizer.

title: Eye Creams Step 2
description: Focus on puffiness and dark circles.
details: Gently massage the cream into the under-eye area to reduce puffiness and dark circles.
tips: Store eye cream in the fridge for cooling effect.
Use twice daily for best results.

title: Eye Creams Step 3
description: Seal with a lightweight moisturizer.
details: Apply a lightweight moisturizer over the eye area to lock in the cream’s benefits.
tips: Avoid heavy creams around eyes.
Use sunscreen during the day for protection.

title: Lip Care Step 1
description: Exfoliate lips gently.
details: Use a lip scrub or soft toothbrush to gently exfoliate dead skin from lips.
tips: Exfoliate 1-2 times per week.
Follow with a hydrating lip balm.

title: Lip Care Step 2
description: Apply a hydrating lip balm.
details: Use a nourishing lip balm with ingredients like shea butter or beeswax to hydrate lips.
tips: Reapply throughout the day as needed.
Choose a balm with SPF for daytime.

title: Lip Care Step 3
description: Use an overnight lip mask.
details: Apply a thick layer of lip mask before bed to repair and hydrate lips overnight.
tips: Use 2-3 times per week for intense hydration.
Remove excess mask in the morning.

title: Exfoliators Step 1
description: Apply exfoliator to clean, damp skin.
details: Use a small amount of exfoliator and gently massage in circular motions for 30 seconds.
tips: Exfoliate 1-3 times per week based on skin sensitivity.
Avoid over-scrubbing to prevent irritation.

title: Exfoliators Step 2
description: Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water.
details: Rinse off all exfoliator residue and pat skin dry with a clean towel.
tips: Use a gentle cleanser afterward if needed.
Follow with a soothing toner.

title: Exfoliators Step 3
description: Hydrate with a moisturizer.
details: Apply a hydrating moisturizer to replenish skin after exfoliation.
tips: Use a calming cream for sensitive skin.
Apply sunscreen during the day.

title: Anti-Aging Step 1
description: Apply an anti-aging serum.
details: Use 2-3 drops of a retinol or peptide-based serum and gently pat onto clean skin.
tips: Start with a low retinol concentration.
Use at night to avoid sun sensitivity.

title: Anti-Aging Step 2
description: Follow with an anti-aging cream.
details: Apply a cream with ingredients like hyaluronic acid or antioxidants to reduce fine lines.
tips: Use a pea-sized amount to avoid irritation.
Apply evenly to face and neck.

title: Anti-Aging Step 3
description: Protect with SPF during the day.
details: Finish with a broad-spectrum SPF 30+ to protect skin from UV damage.
tips: Reapply sunscreen every 2 hours.
Use a lightweight SPF for daily wear.
